notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Cleansing Fire has at least one divinity counter on it.
Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Cast Hautli's Raptor by paying {G}{W}.
When Hautli's Raptor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Cleansing Fire and an indestructible counter on Myojin of Grim Betrayal.
Activate Myojin of Cleansing Fire by removing a divinity counter from it, destroying each other creature.
Activate Myojin of Grim Betrayal by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning all creature cards that were put into a graveyard this turn to the battlefield under your control.
Repeat from step 2.
You may repeat this combo infinitely for infinite proliferate, ETB, LTB and death triggers, or you may do it as desired during any following turn.
